default: absent -> inside a script started by a key binding, that key; anywhere else -> "bind: 'key' omitted outside a script started by a key binding - write 'key <key>', such as 'key SHIFT+KP_8'"; a token the engine cannot read -> "unknown key '<key>': write [CTRL+][KWIN+][SUPER+][SHIFT+][ALT+] then an SDL scancode name without SDL_SCANCODE_, such as SHIFT+KP_8; a joystick button or hat direction as BUTTON3 or HAT0_UP, no prefix and no _ALT (a binding serves both sets of the joystick's ini); or * for every key"
doc: The key, joystick button or hat direction that runs the scripts; left out inside a script a key started, that key.
name: key
notes: The modifiers are part of the key: SHIFT+KP_8 and KP_8 are two keys, each with its own bindings (src/uiModule/key_binding.cpp:165-177 @ 52568219).
value_domain: a key token, in any case: [CTRL+][KWIN+][SUPER+][SHIFT+][ALT+] then an SDL scancode name without SDL_SCANCODE_ (such as SHIFT+KP_8), the modifiers accepted in any order; a joystick button or hat direction as BUTTON<n> or HAT<n>_<UP|DOWN|LEFT|RIGHT>, with no modifier and no _ALT; or * for every key
